tools.name: omnipost_platform_specs
tools.description: FREE. Verified character limits, title limits, hashtag caps, image ratios/pixel sizes, link behavior and publishing method for 14 social platforms. Use before writing any social post.

tools.name: omnipost_validate
tools.description: FREE. Deterministically checks platform-specific post variants against verified limits (X weighted count, Instagram 5-hashtag cap, Telegram caption limit, title limits, dead links, hook-below-fold) and returns a 0–100 format-compliance Fit Score per platform.

tools.name: omnipost_share_intents
tools.description: FREE. Builds official one-tap share URLs (X, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit, WhatsApp, Telegram, Bluesky, Pinterest, Facebook) for each variant, plus copy-and-open targets for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Google Business.

tools.name: omnipost_payment_contract
tools.description: FREE. x402 v2 payment terms for OmniPost paid tools: network, USDC asset, payTo, facilitator, headers and current prices.

tools.name: omnipost_fanout
tools.description: PAID x402 ($0.05 USDC hosted model, or $0.01 with your own provider key). Rewrites one post into native versions for up to 14 platforms, validates every variant, auto-repairs violations, and returns hooks, Fit Scores and share intents. Never invents facts.

tools.name: omnipost_media_pack
tools.description: PAID x402 ($0.01 USDC). Turns one image into every platform's exact ratio and pixel size (16:9, 4:5, 1:1, 9:16, 2:3, 4:3) with focal-point cropping. Returns data URLs.

tools.name: omnipost_publish
tools.description: PAID x402 ($0.01 USDC per call, up to 20 targets). Publishes directly to Discord (webhook), Telegram (bot), Bluesky (app password) and any Zapier/Make/n8n webhook. Credentials are used once and never stored.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "omnipost_publish" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: PAID x402 ($0.01 USDC per call, up to 20 targets). Publishes directly to Discord (webhook), Telegram (bot), Bluesky (app password) and any Zapier/Make/n8n webho…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: omnipost_share_intents · Private data: omnipost_publish · Public sink: omnipost_platform_specs, omnipost_validate, omnipost_share_intents, omnipost_fanout, omnipost_publish · Destructive: omnipost_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: omnipost_share_intents · Private data: omnipost_publish · Public sink: omnipost_platform_specs, omnipost_validate, omnipost_share_intents, omnipost_fanout, omnipost_publish · Destructive: omnipost_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
